label: Arbitrary object sets and repeated operations do not settle constitution
paraphrase: For every object carrier and selected object set, one actual Unit operation has precisely that incidence profile and a complete intrinsic token profile, with an intrinsic realizer both in the simple one-constituent assignment and in a composite subject assignment. All Nat objects can therefore belong to one represented act, while this fact alone leaves subject simplicity unsettled. Countably many repeated operations have the same two-object profile and one realizer but distinct exercise indices; profile completeness and local unity hold at each exercise while the full token carrier is not a subsingleton. Further populated controls retain countably many operations at one bearer/exercise while omitting, separately, profile completeness, intrinsic membership, or subject simplicity. No control establishes cognitive correctness, eternal act identity or metaphysical possibility.
